ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 80% high-intensity white/light-grey pixels to 20% low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels concentrated along margins and notch.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white central lobe regions; continuous black banding along the entire trailing edge (approx. 5-10 pixel width); localized dark pixel clusters (spots) scattered across both lobes, with a higher frequency on the right lobe; vertical dark stripe at the central notch extending toward the peduncle.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression; internal angle approximately 45 degrees; bounding box depth relative to total fluke height is roughly 1:5.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations across the entire trailing edge; distinct peaks (spikes) located at the distal tips; a notable indentation/notch on the left lobe trailing edge at roughly 60% distance from the center.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-convex curve; lobes sweep upward and outward from the peduncle with a gradual convex arc that sharpens toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple dark circular rings (likely barnacle scars) visible: a cluster of three distinct rings on the left lobe upper-mid section; several isolated rings on the right lobe near the trailing edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several thin, dark linear disruptions; a series of 3-4 parallel diagonal rake marks on the far left lobe; a long horizontal abrasion mark crossing the upper right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive clusters of white barnacles (Coronula diadema) attached to the distal tips of both the left and right lobes; numerous circular and linear pigmented scars across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly irregular 'dripping' pattern of black pigmentation along the interface of the white ventral surface and the black trailing edge margin.
